That looks good. Your future at FormFactor:

- Hello future!  As part of our large FormFactor family, you will play an active role in shaping current and upcoming technologies.
- Bye-bye monotony!  The challenging, varied tasks in the field of artificial intelligence and infrared applications as well as flat hierarchies offer you a lot of freedom for design and innovation.

- Just get started.  With our New Hire training plan, you will arrive relaxed your new tasks.

- Accuracy, punctuality, good team and interpersonal skills Willingness to travel

About Huawei

Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. With integrated solutions across four key domains – telecom networks, IT, smart devices, and cloud services – we are committed to bringing digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world.

At Huawei, innovation focuses on customer needs. We invest heavily in basic research, concentrating on technological breakthroughs that drive the world forward. We have more than 208,000 employees, and we operate in more than 170 countries and regions.

Huawei's end-to-end portfolio of products, solutions and services are both competitive and secure. Through open collaboration with ecosystem partners, we create lasting value for our customers, working to empower people, enrich home life, and inspire innovation in organizations of all shapes and sizes.

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer – Advanced Materials (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Chemietechnik)
jobs.description:
Your Challenge

In your role as Process Engineer, you will be responsible for operating an AIXTRON CCS or Planetary system in our application laboratory. You will serve as the direct contact for the Simulation and Design departments regarding process optimization and further development of reactor hardware. In addition, you will work closely with colleagues from Sales & Marketing and conduct system demonstrations to support customer acquisition. You will also contribute to cooperation projects with internal and external partners.

- As a process engineer in the AIXTRON application laboratory, you will actively and independently shape the development and optimization of our deposition reactors and processes for compound semiconductor deposition
- Thanks to your independent and well-coordinated working style, you will plan and manage cross-departmental projects to further develop our deposition processes and drive the evaluation of hardware prototypes
- Your fascination with technology and your pursuit of perfection will motivate you to design and coordinate sometimes coompley test series with development projects
- Turning data into information: With your structured and scientific analytical approach, you will recognize complex relationships and draw conclusions from experimental series
- As a multiplier of our know-how, you will carefully analyze and document the knowledge and experience gained and share it with colleagues and team members
- You will be able to adapt processes developed in the laboratory to customer requirements and transfer them to customer systems, making a key contribtuion to ensuring our customers' rapid success

Your Profile

- You hold a degree in a scientific or technical field, e.g., Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a comparable qualification
- During your studies and professional experience, you have developed solid expertise in CMOS technology, advanced material deposition, semiconductor processing, and solid-state physics. In addition, you possess in-depth knowledge of epitaxial growth processes for both Group III–V and Group IV materials, which you confidently apply in practice
- You have process experience in semiconductor deposition, ideally using RPCVD on a commercial epitaxy system. Knowledge of other growth techniques such as MBE, ALD, or sputtering is also advantageous
- You are experienced in handling various characterization methods and solid-state physics-related questions and have worked with measurement equipment
- You have good written and spoken English skills
- You are flexible and open to international travel (approximately 5–10%)

What you can expect from us

- Flexible working hours: No fixed core hours, mobile working options, and the ability to switch between office and mobile office
- Vacation: 30 vacation days as standard, with the option to increase annually through salary conversion
- Profit sharing: Opportunity to participate in the company’s success and benefit from profit sharing
- Health: Promotion of your physical and mental health through regular health initiatives
- Further development: Continuous development through the AIXTRON Academy and individual support programs
- Retirement and additional insurance: Support for pension plans, capital-forming benefits, and additional insurance options
- Catering: Subsidized meals in the company cafeteria and fresh seasonal fruit baskets
- Open corporate culture: Open and respectful informal culture (“Duz”) across all hierarchy levels
- Sustainability and mobility: E-charging stations for cars and bicycles, good public transport connections, and free parking
- Employee referral program: Attractive rewards for referring new talent to AIXTRON

Process Operator (f/m/d)

Place of work: Production site, near Chemnitz, Germany
Start date: ASAP
Contract type: Full-time

About us

We’re on a mission to revolutionize how the world produces protein and we’re just getting started.

Pacifico is a Leipzig-based biotech company producing the world’s most cost-competitive texturized protein through fermentation. Our technology makes sustainable, high-quality protein cheaper than conventional meat production – not just better for the planet, but better for you.

Our production site near Chemnitz is where science meets scale: industrial fermentation systems, food-grade processing lines, and a team that moves fast. We’re now looking for a Process Operator (f/m/d) to support the day-to-day facility operations at our production site.

The role

In this role, you will support the operations of our fermentation facility and all related processing steps. You will work closely with a Senior Process Lead and will be trained on our equipment, processes, and quality standards.

The role is strongly hands-on and operational, with a focus on running equipment, preparing materials, and supporting production. Working hours are initially within typical daytime working hours; as production scales, openness to late and occasional weekend shifts is valued.

Your main tasks

- Preparation of fermentation media (weighing, mixing, heating, handling raw materials)
- Operating fermentation tanks and auxiliary equipment
- Supporting downstream processing (emptying tanks, handling and processing biomass)
- Operating our food processing line and its associated equipment
- Monitoring basic process parameters (e.g. temperature, time, filling levels)
- Cleaning and sanitising equipment (CIP systems and manual cleaning)
- Maintaining cleanliness, order, and safety in the facility
- Documenting basic production activities and flagging issues when they arise

Your profile

- Practical experience in food & beverage or similar manufacturing environments
- Comfortable working in a production setting with physical tasks and machinery
- Careful, reliable, and quality-oriented working style
- Interest in food production and fermentation processes
- Ability to work well in a small team and communicate clearly on the shop floor
- Basic working knowledge of English

Nice to have

- Experience in a brewery, dairy or fermentation-based production
- Technical or vocational training in a relevant field
- Familiarity with hygiene standards and food safety practices
- Experience with CIP systems or industrial cleaning routines
- Basic working knowledge of German

What we offer

- A full-time role with clear responsibilities and growth opportunities
- 28 days of paid holiday per year
- Subsidy for the Germany Ticket (“Deutschland-Ticket”)
- Hands-on training and close collaboration with experienced colleagues

How to apply

A short CV/brief overview of your previous work experience is sufficient.

jobs.occupation: Head of Unified Data Layer (d/f/m) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
About this Position 

What you´ll do

- Define and drive Henkel’s Unified Data Layer strategy and roadmap, establishing a trusted, reusable, and AI-ready data foundation that connects data, business context, and knowledge across the enterprise
- Build and lead the Unified Data Layer organization, covering data architecture management, semantic technologies, metadata and knowledge management, and unified data experience capabilities
- Establish and govern the enterprise-wide semantic backbone, including business definitions, metadata, knowledge graphs, data contracts, lineage, quality standards, and ownership models to ensure one trusted version of truth
- Own the Unified Data Experience, enabling humans and AI agents to discover, understand, request, access, and consume trusted data products through a seamless one-stop-shop experience
- Scale the enterprise data product ecosystem, defining standards, lifecycle management, interoperability requirements, API strategies, and domain ownership models to make data reusable by design
- Enable interoperability across the data and technology landscape, connecting platforms such as SAP, Databricks, Power BI, Fabric, Salesforce, and future ecosystem services through a unified architectural framework

What makes you a good fit

- Master’s degree in computer science, data management, business informatics, engineering, or a related field
- At least 8 years of experience in data architecture, data governance, data products, or enterprise data transformation, with proven leadership of complex teams and initiatives
- Strong business acumen and ability to translate business needs into reusable data products, semantic standards, and scalable enterprise data capabilities
- Expert knowledge of data mesh, metadata management, semantic layers, knowledge graphs, data contracts, APIs, and data quality frameworks
- Excellent skills and acumen in building trusted, governed, and user-centric data access experiences for business users, BI solutions, and AI agents and advanced knowledge of modern data ecosystems and interoperability patterns across cloud, Lakehouse, SAP, BI, unstructured data, and AI/agentic architectures
- Fluent in English; German language skill is a plus

Some perks of joining Henkel

- Flexible work scheme with flexible hours, hybrid work model, and work from anywhere policy for up to 30 days per year
- Diverse national and international growth opportunities
- Global wellbeing standards with health and preventive care programs
- Gender-neutral parental leave for a minimum of 8 weeks
- Employee Share Plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares
- Company Pension Plan 100% financed by Henkel
- MEGA Preventive Health Insurance
- CareFlex Supplementary Care Insurance
- Mobility offer: My Henkel Bike and Jobticket

At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Become part of the team and bring your uniqueness to us! We welcome all applications across different genders, origins, cultures, religions, sexual orientations, generations and disabilities. If there are any specific accommodations or adjustments you require for the interview process or your on-site appointment, please inform us, and we'll do our best to accommodate your requests.

Note: The email address you provide during the application process may also be used in later stages (e.g. for contract execution via digital tools). Please ensure that only you have access to this mailbox and that you can securely receive confidential information through it.

jobs.description:
GOTEC Group is an internationally operating, innovative company in the fields of surface coating, plastic injection molding, metal processing, and mechanical engineering, and a strategic partner to the global automotive industry. 

As we continue to grow, we are always looking for dedicated talent and experienced experts. 

To strengthen our team, we are currently looking for a:

IT Consultant / Application Specialist ERP **(m/f/d)**
Location: Wülfrath / Remote / Global Responsibility

Your Profile:

We expect you to think and act independently, to organize yourself well, and to be a motivated, pragmatic team player with a hands-on mentality and a can-do attitude, who is well versed in common office software. In addition, we specifically expect the following from you:

- Degree in IT, Business Informatics, or comparable technical background
- Solid experience with ERP systems, ideally Comarch, SAP Business One, or similar
- Practical knowledge of EDI processes and business process harmonization
- Experience supporting international rollouts, ideally in manufacturing or automotive
- Structured, analytical way of working with a hands-on mindset
- Strong communication skills and ability to work with key users across sites
- Occasional willingness to travel
- Fluent English and Polish required

Nice to Have:

- Ability to collaborate with developers on application development and design
- Practical knowledge of SQL

Your Responsibilities:

If you want to face the exciting challenges of the automotive industry every day and keep a cool head in stressful situations, the following tasks await you after intensive onboarding:

- Support the Team Lead Applications ERP in daily operations and project execution
- Act as key contact for key users across sites on ERP and EDI topics
- Support the rollout and harmonization of Comarch ERP and EDI projects
- Contribute to standardization of processes, master data and best practices
- Prepare and maintain KPI reports and application performance data
- Assist in testing, documentation and training for new rollouts

What We Offer:

At GOTEC, you can expect varied and demanding tasks in a dynamic team with flat hierarchies, as well as excellent professional development and advancement opportunities. Naturally, we provide you with a modern workplace and up to date technical equipment, and we also offer you an attractive salary package. 

Take the decisive career step now and send your compelling application, including your salary expectations and earliest possible start date, to:

hr@gotec-group.com (https://mailto:hr@gotec-group.com)
